integrity: The new comparison is proved by a finite summation-by-parts identity and Cauchy--Schwarz; the optimality example is bounded analytically. The logarithmic thresholds use standard integral tests. The accompanying verifier is corroborative only and does not replace the infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to positive nonincreasing radial perturbations of the critical field on a Cayley tree. The phase-transition and uniqueness consequences inherit the temperature regimes and Gibbs-measure framework of the cited source. No claim is made for nonmonotone or nonradial fields or for general trees.
title: Sharp weighted-square criterion and logarithmic boundary at the critical Cayley-tree Ising field
